nodes.statement: One selected consumer receives fixed motor input M and proprioceptive/state input P on a same-bearer, same-interval, same-context two-by-two intervention domain; output endpoint and actual intake events remain distinct.
nodes.scope: Frozen finite model; actual application requires bearer, interval, complete signature, plant/branch separation, carriers, consumer, endpoint, context and intervention fidelity.
nodes.quantifier: Universal over the displayed finite function class; conditional for actual applications.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Active/passive labels do not instantiate this domain; context changes require enlargement.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Motor-only missing corner fixes plant consequence while varying consumer inputs.

nodes.statement: The common triangle observes endpoint values at 00, 01 and 11 but not 10.
nodes.scope: One endpoint and the frozen MPC:DOMAIN only.
nodes.all_premises: Fixed cell meanings and endpoint comparability.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A different physical protocol may not preserve these cell meanings.

nodes.statement: Every Boolean three-corner profile has exactly two completions, differing only at 10.
nodes.scope: All deterministic Boolean endpoint functions in MPC:DOMAIN.
nodes.quantifier: For every function and every observed profile in the displayed class.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Stochastic, real-valued and context-varying cases need separate contracts.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Separates M from M AND P, and P from M OR P.

nodes.statement: k unconstrained endpoint coordinates leave 2^k three-corner completions.
nodes.quantifier: For every positive integer k in the declared class.
nodes.all_premises: MPC:C1 for every endpoint and no cross-endpoint restriction.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Independent cross-endpoint premises can reduce the count.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Blocks scalarization of intensity, precision, agency, ownership and report.

nodes.statement: Full endpoint-response equality does not entail equality of actual input-read occurrences.
nodes.quantifier: Existential counterexample to unrestricted response-to-intake inference.
nodes.all_premises: Declared eager/lazy execution traces and same OR table.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Validated event instruments or additional sole-route premises can separate the pair.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Copy/switch fixes table and varies intake occurrence.

nodes.statement: Perceived intensity/bias, discrimination precision, agency, ownership and report are separate endpoints; attention and body-state context can alter different coordinates.
nodes.scope: Cited primary protocols only; no raw-data reanalysis or universal biology.
nodes.quantifier: Source-bounded existential dissociations and protocol constraints.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Does not identify a universal endpoint tensor or anatomical gate.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Passive goal-cue rival defeats motor-only reading of precision.

nodes.statement: An independently grounded actual consumer relation has an experience-internal structural counterpart under C1; no named endpoint or basal gate follows.
nodes.scope: One actual same-instance token with complete declared signature and every application premise discharged.
nodes.quantifier: Conditional universal application of C1 to admitted actual tokens.
nodes.all_premises: Actual token, complete signature, actual consumer events, intervention fidelity and A:C1.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: No actual token, H, agency, ownership, intensity, sensitivity or report mapping is supplied.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Ancestors/formation prevents a new consciousness threshold.

rules.binding: same intervention cells across k separately typed endpoints; no cross-endpoint bridge
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Endpoint tensor supplies typing, not independence; no-cross-endpoint restriction is explicit in C2 scope.

rules.alternative_route_semantics: Countermodel blocks unrestricted inference; it does not deny stronger instrumented routes.

rules.alternative_route_semantics: No phenomenal endpoint is inferred; C1 is axiomatic and every actual-instance premise remains conjunctive.
